Eva hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Eva plays table tennis with Anna every Monday. Eva drinks milk after doing sports. Housekeeping comes after ten.
Last Monday, Eva and Anna went to the old town. Both of them like salad and milk. Eva usually has salad for breakfast. The brick facade dates from 1820.
Eva learned a lot about math. Life is full of small surprises. Eva and Anna had great fun there. The highway links the two cities.
The old town is one of the best places in the city. It takes twenty minutes to get to the old town by bike. Eva wrote about the day in the diary.
